initialize_sharded_tensor_uniform: initialize a ShardedTensor with values drawn from a uniform distribution over a specified range
initialize_sharded_tensor_normal: initialize a ShardedTensor with values drawn from a normal distribution with specified mean and standard deviation
initialize_sharded_tensor_kaiming_unifor: initialize a ShardedTensor using Kaiming (He) uniform initialization for use with ReLU-style activations
fill_sharded_tensor_constant: fill a ShardedTensor with a constant value across all local shards
create_sharded_tensor_like: create a new ShardedTensor with the same shape as an existing ShardedTensor using zeros, ones, rand, or full
